name: vault-stash-session
summary: Create a compact resume note for continuing paused or interrupted vault work in a later runtime session.
done_when: a dated resume note is created under harness/resume/
the resume note includes objective, current state, changed files, decisions, blockers, validation, and next action
harness/memory.md points to the resume-note index or latest note
verification: verify the resume note contains the required sections
verify harness/memory.md links to resume notes
verify changed Markdown/frontmatter where files were edited
